xsd.validator: xmllint (libxml2) vs x3d-4.0.xsd from x3d_mcp + XSD patched: Viewport added to the Full child content model

scope: the layer's viewport (clip rectangle) and a Viewport node in the world are compared with X_ITE 16.6.0 as pictures (silhouette iou 1.0, mean difference 1.3 to 1.6 of 255 on Chromium 153.0.8010.12 SwiftShader / Babylon 9.32.0; bound iou 0.97, mad 4): in a layer the rectangle is the layer's own projection, in the world the projection of the whole canvas is squeezed into the rectangle (both as X_ITE does)

a Viewport in the world is drawn by a camera of its own over the world, with the depth cleared between the two; X_ITE keeps one depth buffer, so a world object in front of the Viewport's content is not hidden behind it here (not compared)
a pointer outside the rectangle does not reach the layer or the Viewport's children (compared with TouchSensors)

XSD finding: x3d-4.0.xsd (x3d_mcp) takes a Viewport as the viewport of a layer, not as a child of Scene or a group; the world-level fixture is checked against the XSD plus one line (xsdAllow, the receipt names it)
